integrity: Self-contained all-multiplicity exterior-minor proof, supplementary reproducible finite-dimensional checks; no independent validation or publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed integer multiplicity and classical one-variable Bargmann–Fock norm; asymptotic as the node separation tends to zero. No uniformity in the multiplicity and no general many-node or noisy interpolation theorem. Earlier displaced-state spectral formulas remain a publication-priority risk.
title: Sharp collision hierarchy for two equal Bargmann–Fock jet clusters
